curated.instructions: omr/instructions/42120-1-1.pdf (the hovercraft; the function overview is page 120)

functions.does: Pushing the hovercraft along spins the two big fans at the back: two hidden rubber-tyred wheels under the hull turn a bevel gear, a shaft running back, two cross shafts and two upright shafts that come up inside the fans' mounts and drive each fan through bevel gears.
functions.source: book: steps 18-20 (the hidden wheels and their 20 tooth bevel gear), 55-56 (the upright shafts), 165-166 (the fans); page 120 shows the fans spinning as it rolls

functions.does: Pushing it along also spins the beacon on the tall post in the middle of the deck, the two blue lights going round: a bevel gear on the post's shaft is driven by the hidden wheels' 20 tooth bevel gear.
functions.source: book: steps 159-160 (the beacon on its post); page 120 shows it spinning

functions.does: The black knob on top of the cabin steers: turning it swings a crossbar underneath, whose two long beams swivel both fans left and right together, and whose short link turns the two small front wheels and the pilot's handlebars.
functions.source: book: steps 43-52 (front wheels, crossbar and links), 150 (the knob), 169 (the handlebars); page 120's inset shows the knob and the fans swivelling
functions.note: Each fan's bevel gear rolls round the upright shaft's gear as the fan swivels, so the fans turn a little while steering.

functions.does: The two small front wheels under the bow roll freely.
The small fan on the front deck spins freely on its pin.
functions.source: inferred: step 168 puts it on a pin with nothing driving it; the book doesn't show it turning

questions.question: Is the front fan undriven, and do the handlebars turn with the wheels?
